headline: Life imprisonment for the founder of the Evergrande giant: five keys to the real estate crisis shaking China
summary: A Chinese court has ended the judicial process stemming from the collapse of Evergrande, which defaulted in 2021. The case is seen as the start of the real estate crisis hitting China's economy for over five years.
why: Evergrande was one of China's largest property developers, and its default triggered a wider property-sector downturn affecting developers, banks and local government finances.
